propositions: Binding lifecycle alerts documented as deduped never suppress duplicates because records lack timestamp_ns field, causing every pass to append another record
alert_store.is_deduped computes now - rec.get('timestamp_ns', 0) and defaults missing timestamp to 0, which exceeds the 24h window check and returns False
BindingRepository.alert and several other callers build records without timestamp_ns, leaving ownership of the field unassigned between caller and append
The fix centralizes timestamp_ns stamping in alert_store.append as {"timestamp_ns": time.time_ns(), **record} so caller-supplied values win and all call sites are covered
Two BindingRepository passes over a corrupt bindings-retired.json file currently append 2 duplicate binding-retired-file-corrupt records, neither with timestamp_ns
